images.title: Amazon Luna controller
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.what: near top-down photo of the controller on a worktop: the outline (right half), the plate's edge, both sticks, the D-pad, face buttons, the small keys and the Luna button
references.author: Montero3456
references.use: measured geometry only (trace.py outline, positions on a 5 mm grid); no pixels shipped
